subject: naga_siren_mirror_image
source_quote: Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

subject: manta
source_quote: Active: Mirror Image. Creates %images_count% images of your hero that last %illusion_duration% seconds.

subject: terrorblade_reflection
note_zh: 制造敌方英雄的无敌倒影；倒影无敌，范围伤害打不到
source_quote: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area.

subject: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
source_quote: Use: Proportion Distortion. Creates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds.

subject: spectre_haunt
note_zh: 对所有敌方英雄各制造一个不可控幻象
source_quote: Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes. Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.

subject: spectre_shadow_step
note_zh: 对目标制造一个不可控幻象
source_quote: Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

subject: dark_seer_normal_punch
note_zh: 从被打的英雄身上打出一个复制体
source_quote: Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim.
